summary: ansible.mysql deprecates MariaDB support for removal in 6.0.0 (not before mid 2027); MariaDB users should switch to the cloned ansible.mariadb collection.
questions: Should I use ansible.mysql or ansible.mariadb for MariaDB?
When will ansible.mysql drop MariaDB support?
What is the ansible.mariadb equivalent of mysql_info?

answer_card.title: MariaDB moving to ansible.mariadb
answer_card.answer_md:
MariaDB support in `ansible.mysql` is deprecated and will be dropped in **6.0.0** (not earlier than mid 2027); until then it gets only bug and security fixes.

If you manage MariaDB, install **`ansible.mariadb`** from Galaxy and change FQCNs, for example `ansible.mysql.mysql_info` → `ansible.mariadb.mariadb_info`. No other changes are needed; it's a clone of ansible.mysql.
